lowerProtection: Original shorts pixels at least two native pixels below the measured per-column waistline and every shoe pixel must remain unchanged. Original trousers/shoes also receive independent native RGBA ownership.
collarProtection: Every opaque original shirt-labelled pixel must be covered, including the full torso and hem, not only rows above 134.
scope: Original activities-10 pre-paint kneeling/tending criteria; full original shirt coverage, native arms/hands, raised-knee and lower-body ownership.
waistMeasurementExtension: Constant extension beyond the original first/last landmarks matches the native material sampler; measured interior points are unchanged.
headProtection: Conservative native face polygon inspected against the unchanged body; shirt paint must not change any appearance channel there. Neck outside this polygon may receive the shirt collar.
